other_text: A FILM BY NICK WILLIAMS "THE GROUP" CONTAINS GUN VIOLENCE (SPACE RAYS), ALIEN INVASION, AND END-OF-THE-WORLD THEMES. STARRING JENNIFER CONNER, EMILY ROSS, AND ADAM KELLER. SPECIAL EFFECTS BY GLENN KOPPER AND STEVEN L. ELSTON. PRODUCED BY DAVID M. HARRIS AND MICHAEL J. SMITH. DISTRIBUTED BY FINAL BOSS PICTURES.
description: A red poster features a central light with six black silhouettes holding snowboards, radiating outward. The title "THE GROUP" is prominently displayed at the bottom.
